title: Operator Lifts Trace Metrics and Representation Limits
description: We compare two representations of a finite real cochain: its diagonal operator and the rank-one projector obtained from its normalized signed square-root coordinates. The diagonal map is injective and preserves the sum-of-absolute-values norm as trace norm. The projector identifies precisely the nonzero scalar multiples of a cochain, losing mass and global orientation while retaining every diagnostic constant on those fibers. Trace distance defines a pseudometric on nonzero cochains and a metric on their real projective quotient. We prove a chain-complex residual bound, describe local reconstruction using an orientation anchor, and show that a continuous global sign choice is impossible in dimension at least two. A guarded evaluator uses these representations under an explicit selection policy. The real-vector arguments are written proofs; the Lean package verifies narrower integer and rational identities. No physical quantum interpretation is asserted.
